model_output:
```sql
WITH lexington_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Lexington'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND addr_state = 'KY'
),
gardens_in_lexington AS (
  SELECT id, poi_name, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE addr_city = 'Lexington'
    AND addr_state = 'KY'
    AND leisure = 'garden'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, 1, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM lexington_region), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM lexington_region))
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT g.id, g.poi_name, ST_Value(r.rast, 1, g.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM gardens_in_lexington g, clipped_dem r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, g.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT *
FROM elevation_analysis
WHERE elevation IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY elevation ASC
LIMIT 10;
```
